setup: v2: setup no longer says the form is fixed by the council; Q2 and Q3 say how the check can look data up; Q3 incident is at this market through an application the check accepted. Prompt: ../prompt.txt (same setup and questions, 5 runs per model).
how: Claude Code general-purpose subagents (model haiku / sonnet), one fresh subagent per run; questions sent one at a time as follow-up messages to the same subagent; RESULT line sent after each YES. Where an answer started with a note before the YES/NO (H1), the YES/NO in its first lines was used.

answers.text:
YES

Noted, the new check caught 1 application this week.

2. YES

YES. The insurance end date has to cover every day in the Days field, or the vendor would be trading uninsured on the days after it lapses, so the check should stamp those applications NOT ACCEPTED.
NO, not as specified. The form has no certificate field, so matching by name against the register would be unreliable, and a new rule like 4.9 needs office sign-off first.
